records.title: GaussVLA: Geometry-Aware Spatial Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Model
records.reason: Primary abstract proposes geometry-aware reasoning for vision-language-action models; it does not claim inference-efficiency or serving improvements.

records.title: HCC+: Hyperbolic Guarding for Certified Attention Retrieval
records.reason: The paper explicitly says validation is synthetic/theoretical, lacks full-scale transformer benchmark and throughput tests, and actual memory savings depend on alignment/metadata. Applicability to LLM inference is not yet demonstrated.

records.title: DataKernelBench: Can LLMs Optimize Database Queries on GPUs?
records.reason: Primary abstract benchmarks LLM-generated database query kernels; the optimization target is database execution kernels, not LLM inference.

records.title: MEPO-SLM: multi-objective evolutionary prompt optimization for energy-efficient small language models on edge devices
records.reason: The primary abstract is available but the article body is behind subscription/access restrictions; methods, tables, baselines, and limits cannot be validated from the retrieved primary material, so retain as borderline.

records.title: Permutation-equivariant deep equilibrium networks for real-time single-bus DER dispatch with O(1) parameter scaling
records.reason: Primary abstract concerns real-time dispatch of distributed energy resources with equilibrium networks, not language models.
